listing.name: Virtua Cop — virtuacop (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Upstream reaches boot, attract, coin/start and a playable first-person stage; stage completion not verified and sound wholly unimplemented. Main game CPU is native C; coprocessor emulation must be disclosed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own vcop/vcopa ROM set including CPU-board math tables opr-14742a.45 and opr-14743a.46. rom_loader produces program/data/polygon/texture/coproc images; generated game C is local and not distributed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local source route: rom_loader.py extracts ROM images, i960_lifter.py generates game C, CMake builds vcop.exe using SDL2/vcpkg. Runtime loads the resulting ROM image directory. No ready player archive is established by this README.
